text: Applicants should: 1. Be under the age of 45 2. Complete Master's Degree with good marks Note: Applicants, who do not meet the above requirements, may be considered on an individual basis. They may be admitted as non-degree seeking students for one academic year. Those who pass the examinations held one year later will be automatically accepted as regular students. Those who fail will return to their home country as scholar study students after completing some courses in a program.
